wiki:
How to obtain:

Genoa - 320,000 ducat investment required; the book will be sold in the Item Shop for 800,000 ducats.
Lubeck - Invest 2,000,000 ducats at the City Official and have at least 1 item space open in your inventory; the book will be given as an investment reward (unless it is already present in your inventory!).
